PlatformAdmin.//Password: Intentionally unset — seeding is skipped without it, so no working credential ships in source control. Set the PlatformAdmin__Password environment variable to seed the SuperAdmin.

Web.//BaseUrl: Where the Blazor app is reachable. Only used to build the invitation acceptance link; override with Web__BaseUrl in any environment that is not local dev.

Communications.//: Provider credentials are platform-wide and come from configuration and secrets, never from tenant-editable data. A channel with no credentials is disabled cleanly: sends against it are recorded as Rejected/ChannelNotConfigured rather than failing at the network layer.
Communications.//UseNoopProviders: true records sends without performing them. Set it for local development so a stray credential cannot message a real customer.

Smtp.//: Host and FromAddress are the minimum to send. Leave Host empty to disable email.
Smtp.//Password: Intentionally unset — set Communications__Smtp__Password in the environment or user-secrets.

Twilio.//: Leave AccountSid empty to disable SMS and WhatsApp.
Twilio.//AuthToken: Intentionally unset — set Communications__Twilio__AuthToken in the environment or user-secrets. It is also the key webhook signatures are verified with.

Communications.//WebhookRoutingSecret: Derives the per-tenant routing token in callback URLs. Set Communications__WebhookRoutingSecret in production.
Communications.//InboundWebhookSecret: Verifies signatures on the generic inbound callback. Set Communications__InboundWebhookSecret in production; without it every callback is refused.
